name: vestaloop_create_event
description: Create a calendar event in the household. Times are UTC ISO-8601 (e.g. 2026-07-28T07:00:00Z) — convert the user's local time to UTC first. `scope` is 'personal' (default) or 'shared' (a cosmetic household-wide tag; it does NOT change which Google calendar the event syncs to). `all_day` defaults to false. Requires a read/write key — a read-only key returns 403. If the member has a linked Google calendar, the event is also pushed there. Returns the created event including its new `id`.

all_day.description: Whether this is an all-day event (default false).
